providers.title: AI Providers
providers.none: No providers yet. Click "Add provider" to get started.
providers.delete_confirm_msg: Remove this provider from the OpenCode config? Its API key in auth.json is removed too.

bulk.title: Bulk-add providers
bulk.desc: One shared endpoint + a list of API keys (one per line). Keys duplicating an existing provider are skipped.

ckey.title: CKey (ckey.vn)
ckey.desc: View your account, usage stats and import models from CKey into the OpenCode config.
ckey.no_providers: No provider uses the CKey endpoint yet (https://api.xah.io/v1).
ckey.lbl_new_key: New account key (from the Profile page on ckey.vn)
ckey.remove_key_confirm_msg: The saved account key for this provider will be deleted (provider and imported models are kept).

provider_modal.npm_hint: Most OpenAI-compatible providers use the first package. Only pick @ai-sdk/openai if the provider/model serves /v1/responses.
provider_modal.url_hint: You can paste a full endpoint — it is trimmed back to the root (e.g. /v1/chat/completions → /v1).
provider_modal.key_hint: Keys go to auth.json for built-in presets, or opencode.json for custom providers.
provider_modal.id_hint_add: Leave empty to auto-generate. Only letters, digits, "_" and "-". Must be unique.
provider_modal.id_hint_edit: Change the ID to rename this provider (models and settings are kept). Must be unique.
provider_modal.id_invalid: ID may only contain letters, digits, "_" and "-" (1–64 chars).
provider_modal.dup_msg: Another provider already uses this Base URL and API Key. Merge into it?
provider_modal.keep_key: Leave empty to keep the current key.

models.title: Models of
models.stale_warning: These models are still in your config but the provider NO LONGER offers them. Untick to remove them.

cleanup.title: Clean up failing providers
cleanup.desc: Test every provider and suggest removing the ones that do not work.
cleanup.delete_confirm_msg: Delete every selected provider? This cannot be undone.
